what.text: This page follows refugees from Belgium in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 113 Belgian refugees, and the United Kingdom hosted 41.6% of them.
After the United Kingdom, the largest hosts are Canada, Germany and Norway.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Belgium, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2005 to 2006, 2008 to 2015 and 2024 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1995 at 5 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
